rules.name: Line amount out of range
rules.description: Line amount must be positive and not exceed the payer cap.
rules.suggested_action: Verify the billed amount against the fee schedule and correct the line.

rules.name: Invalid quantity
rules.description: Quantity must be between 1 and the allowed maximum.

rules.name: Service outside coverage period
rules.description: Encounter and service dates must fall within the coverage period.
rules.suggested_action: Confirm the member was covered on the service date or bill the correct payer.

rules.name: Missing prior authorization
rules.description: Listed procedures require a prior authorization reference.
rules.suggested_action: Obtain and attach the authorization number before submission.

rules.name: Duplicate line in claim
rules.description: The same procedure appears twice on the same date within one claim.
rules.suggested_action: Remove the duplicate line or justify it (e.g. modifier).

rules.name: Duplicate across claims
rules.description: Same patient, procedure and date appear in another claim of the batch.
rules.suggested_action: Check whether this service was already billed; withdraw one claim.

rules.name: Missing diagnosis
rules.description: A claim needs at least one diagnosis and a primary diagnosis.
rules.suggested_action: Add the diagnosis codes from the clinical documentation.

rules.name: Invalid diagnosis code format
rules.description: Diagnosis codes must follow the ICD-10 format.

rules.name: Invalid provider identifier
rules.description: Provider NPI must be present and have 10 digits.
rules.suggested_action: Add or correct the provider NPI.

rules.name: Inconsistent encounter dates
rules.description: Encounter end must not precede start; service dates must be within the encounter.
rules.suggested_action: Correct the encounter or service dates.

rules.name: Patient birth date problem
rules.description: Birth date must be present and not after the encounter.

rules.name: Currency problem
rules.description: Every line needs a currency and a claim must use a single currency.
rules.suggested_action: Set one valid currency on all lines.
